articles.excerpt: Now that Commander players have fully sunk their teeth into the Avatar set, let's see which cards they're playing the most.

Will Super-Skrull unseat Kenrith as the go-to five-color goodstuff commander for cEDH? Let's see what it can do in this deck tech.

articles.value: Building Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk for cEDH
articles.excerpt: Does Bruce Banner, aka the Incredible Hulk, have what it takes to smash cEDH tables? Let's take a look at this deck tech to find out.
